description: Closed-loop control recipes for the Wattsonic MATIC inverter: preconditions, write sequence, confirmation and failure/recovery. Values are raw register values; negative values are sent as 16-bit two's complement. Function codes: 0x03 read holding registers, 0x06 write single register, 0x10 write multiple registers.

recipes.title: Open an EMS control session with communications watchdog and heartbeat
recipes.summary: Arms the communications watchdog, opens EMS control (11060 + 12002) and keeps it alive with the heartbeat on 12026. Every native setpoint (11045, 11300-11303, 11320-11324, 11330) is used only while this session is active.

preconditions.text: Modbus TCP connection to port 502, unit identifier 1. Use one connection for all writes: a write from a second connection is answered with exception 0x06 (another client holds write control).
Firmware applies: 13021 >= 1130.
The device is a MATIC inverter: 13016 reads 10-14.
You are on an EMS-native channel: 14030 reads 0x1018 (4120).
Read the rated power 13034 (0.01 kW) to clamp your setpoints.

steps.description: Watchdog timeout in seconds.
Timeout action: 0 stop inverter, 1 self-consumption, 2 hold last state, 3 zero export.

Recovery behaviour: 0 LATCH, 1 AUTO-RESUME, 2 MANUAL_CONFIRM. Write it before 11700 = 1: while the watchdog runs (14031 = 1, 2 or 3, except the start-up SAFE_STATE with 14042 = 6) or is latched, a write to 11704 is answered with exception 0x03.
Enable the communications watchdog.
Enable external EMS dispatch.
Remote control mode.
Heartbeat: any value except 0x5A5A (0x5A5A trips the watchdog on purpose, 14042 = 2). A counter is a good choice.

repeat.interval: every 1-5 s (keeps 14041 far below the 11701 timeout and its 11703 pre-warning, keeps write control on port 502, which is released after 30 s without an executed write, and meets the 5 s window of the MANUAL_CONFIRM / LATCH recovery)

failure_and_recovery: Without a heartbeat for 11701 s the inverter enters SAFE_STATE (14031 = 3, cause in 14042) and applies the 11702 action. Recover with recipe native.recover_safe_state.
14042 = 4: EMS control was closed (11060 or 12002 not 1) while the watchdog was enabled.
After a restart 12002 reads 0 and 11045 reads 0; if the EMS was in control before, the unit starts in SAFE_STATE with 14042 = 6. Continue with recipe native.resume_after_restart.
Exception 0x06 on a write: another connection holds write control; write from one connection only.
notes: Optional pre-warning: 11703 (seconds before the timeout, lower than 11701) makes 14031 read 2 before the trip.
SunSpec writes do not count as the heartbeat; while 11700 is not 0 the heartbeat on 12026 must continue.

recipes.title: Set the active-power setpoint (11045)
recipes.summary: Commands battery charge/discharge through the total AC active-power setpoint. Writing 11045 during an active EMS session puts the inverter into EMS dispatch (mode 20).

preconditions.text: EMS control session active (recipe native.ems_session_start).
Watchdog normal.
Inverter in PCS state 1 (Standby) or 8 (Running).

steps.description: Active power, 0.01 kW, positive = discharge, negative = charge from the grid (1500 = discharge 15.00 kW, -1000 = charge 10.00 kW). Values outside -2500..+2500 are clamped without an exception; the inverter also limits the setpoint to its rated power (13034).
Setpoint Shadow of 11045: 14250 requested, 14251 applied, 14253 rejection flag.
steps.check: 14251 = 14250 and 14253 = 0; 14253 = 1 means the value was clamped

failure_and_recovery: The setpoint is executed only while the EMS is in control; if the watchdog trips (14031 = 3) the 11702 action applies instead.
11045 is not retained: after a restart it reads 0. Write it again once the EMS is back in control.
When EMS control has been interrupted and re-established, write 11045 again: the inverter returns to EMS dispatch only on a new 11045 write.
notes: Write the setpoint again whenever your dispatch value changes; keep the heartbeat running.

recipes.title: Cap the discharge setpoint with Active_Power_Limit_Pct (11320 / 11321) during EMS dispatch
recipes.summary: Caps the positive (discharge) active-power setpoint at a percentage of the rated power while the inverter runs EMS dispatch (mode 20).

preconditions.text: EMS control session active.
EMS dispatch: 11045 written in this session (recipe native.active_power_setpoint).

steps.description: Enable the percentage limit (single-register write).
Limit in 0.1 % of the rated power (700 = 70.0 %). Values above 1000 are answered with exception 0x03.

confirm.meaning: read 17284-17360 in one request: 4 = limit applied under EMS control, 3 = requested but not applied

failure_and_recovery: Outside EMS dispatch the limit is not applied (17290 = 3, 17358 = 1). For a feed-in cap that holds in every operating mode use Export_Limits 11113 with 11107 = 1.
Values written over Modbus TCP port 502 are held in RAM: write 11320 and 11321 again after every restart.
notes: Write 11320 and 11321 with function code 0x06, one register per request; an 0x10 block across 11320-11324 does not reach these settings.

recipes.title: Set the reactive-power mode and setpoint (11300-11303)
recipes.summary: Fixed reactive power (mode 1, setpoint 11302) or fixed power factor (mode 2, setpoint 11301), used while the EMS is in control.

preconditions.text: EMS control session active; otherwise the grid-code settings apply.

steps.description: Mode first: 0 off, 1 fixed reactive power Q (11302), 2 fixed power factor (11301), 3 Q(U), 4 Cos-phi(P).
Reactive power, 0.01 kVar, positive = leading (capacitive), negative = lagging (inductive).
Power factor, 0.001, stored with 0.01 resolution: write multiples of 10 (994 reads back 990).

confirm.meaning: mode in use while the EMS is in control
0.01 kVar; reactive power flows only while the inverter exchanges active power

failure_and_recovery: Use function code 0x06 for each register: an 0x10 block across 11300-11303 does not reach these settings.
When the EMS is not in control (14044 = 0 or 14031 = 3) the grid-code settings apply.
Values written over Modbus TCP port 502 are held in RAM: write mode and setpoint again after every restart.
notes: 11303 (0.01 kVar, 0..10000) is the upper limit of the reactive-power command; factory default 10000.

recipes.title: Program the Eco time schedule (11151 = 2, periods from 11190)
recipes.summary: Runs the battery on a daily time schedule: up to 24 periods of 3 registers each (start, end, type) from 11190, weekday mask 11254.

preconditions.text: Inverter clock and time zone correct (11006): periods use local inverter time.
Eco SOC band inactive: keep 11262 / 11263 at 0 while you use periods.
The inverter runs its own operating mode: no native EMS dispatch (11045) and no SunSpec forced storage command is active.

steps.description: Eco mode (value 4 selects a different time-of-use mode).
Period 1: 00:00-07:00, type 1 = charge.
Period 2: 07:00-17:00, type 2 = self-consumption.
Period 3: 17:00-23:00, type 0 = discharge.
Weekday mask 0x7F = every day (bit0 = Monday to bit6 = Sunday). Single-register write.
Grid-tied minimum SOC, 0.01 % (1000 = 10.00 %).
Grid-tied maximum SOC, 0.01 % (10000 = 100.00 %).
Read the periods back.

failure_and_recovery: A period applies while start <= time < end (minutes from midnight); outside all periods, and on days not in 11254, the inverter runs self-consumption.
An Eco SOC band wider than 4.00 % (11263 - 11262 > 400, BMS-connected battery) takes precedence over the periods. The band registers 11262-11268 read 0 after every restart.
Charge and discharge power per period, and grid charging in charge periods, follow the installer settings (factory: 100 % of rated power, charging from PV).
notes: Period type (11192 and every third register after it): 0 = discharge, 1 = charge, 2 = self-consumption.
Periods you do not use: write start = end = 0 (such a period never applies).

recipes.title: Recover from the watchdog SAFE_STATE (14031 = 3)
recipes.summary: Returns the communications watchdog to normal according to the recovery behaviour in 11704.

preconditions.text: Watchdog tripped.
Read the cause promptly: with LATCH the true reason (1-4) is readable for about 1 s, then 14042 reads 5.
Read the recovery behaviour (while latched it reads 0 = LATCH).
EMS control open: 11060 = 1 and 12002 = 1 (after a restart write 12002 = 1 first); recovery is processed only while EMS control is open.

steps.description: Resume the heartbeat: the first heartbeat returns the watchdog to normal.

repeat.interval: every 1-5 s (keeps 14041 far below the 11701 timeout and its 11703 pre-warning, keeps write control on port 502, which is released after 30 s without an executed write, and meets the 5 s window of the MANUAL_CONFIRM / LATCH recovery)

steps.description: With the heartbeat running every 1-5 s, write 12001 = 1 right after a heartbeat; the next heartbeat returns the watchdog to normal.
LATCH, step 1: disable the watchdog. Keep the heartbeat running every 1-5 s during the whole LATCH sequence.
LATCH, step 2: at least 2 s later, right after a heartbeat, clear the latch.
LATCH with stop action: at least 2 s later switch the inverter on again.
LATCH, last step: re-enable the watchdog and resume the heartbeat.
Write your active-power setpoint again (EMS dispatch resumes only on a new 11045 write).

failure_and_recovery: LATCH: writing 12001 while the watchdog is enabled does not clear the latch; follow the order 11700 = 0, wait >= 2 s, 12001 = 1, wait >= 2 s, (12000 = 1 if 11702 = 0), 11700 = 1.
While the latch is set it survives a power cycle and 11704 reads back as LATCH.
With 11702 = 0 (stop) the trip switches the inverter off: production returns only after 12000 = 1.
12001 = 1 confirms the recovery only if a heartbeat arrived within the last 5 s; otherwise send a heartbeat and write 12001 = 1 again.
14042 = 4: EMS control was closed (11060 or 12002 not 1); write 11060 = 1 and 12002 = 1 again.
notes: A watchdog in SAFE_STATE also refuses SunSpec writes (machine veto) and releases held SunSpec controls.

recipes.title: Resume EMS control after an inverter restart
recipes.summary: After a restart 12002 and 11045 read 0, RAM-held settings are gone and, if the EMS was in control before, the unit starts in SAFE_STATE (14042 = 6) until the EMS's first write.

preconditions.text: New Modbus TCP session to port 502; read 14030 = 0x1018.
Start-up state.

read.expected: 6 if the EMS was in control before the restart

preconditions.text: Stored session settings: 11700, 11701, 11702, 11704 and 11060 survive the restart; check them.

steps.description: First heartbeat: ends the start-up SAFE_STATE (14042 = 6), whatever 11704 says.

repeat.interval: every 1-5 s (keeps 14041 far below the 11701 timeout and its 11703 pre-warning, keeps write control on port 502, which is released after 30 s without an executed write, and meets the 5 s window of the MANUAL_CONFIRM / LATCH recovery)

steps.description: Remote control mode again (reads 0 after every restart).
Active-power setpoint again (reads 0 after a restart).

failure_and_recovery: If 11060 or 11700 do not read 1, run recipe native.ems_session_start.
If 14031 stays 3 with 14042 = 5, the LATCH is set: run recipe native.recover_safe_state.
Write again every value that is held in RAM and that you use: 11320/11321, 11300-11303, 11068/11069 (when written over Modbus TCP) and the Eco SOC band 11262-11268.
SunSpec controls are released by a restart: re-send the SunSpec commands that are to remain in force.

recipes.title: Emergency stop (12021) and restart after clearance
recipes.summary: Stops all power conversion at once and latches until it is cleared with 12001.

preconditions.text: No unlock register is needed. Do not write 12007 or 12008 (they are not the emergency stop).

steps.description: Emergency stop: immediately cease all power conversion; latches.
PCS state.
Clear the emergency stop latch and recoverable faults.
Switch the inverter on again.

confirm.expected: 1 after the stop; 8 after the restart

failure_and_recovery: While 12021 is set the inverter stays off: 12000 = 1 alone does not restart it; clear with 12001 = 1 first.
While the emergency stop is set SunSpec writes are refused with 0x04 and held SunSpec controls are released.
After a restart with the native EMS session, write the heartbeat, 12002 = 1 and 11045 again.
notes: Check the alarm and fault registers (14100 onward) before the restart.

recipes.title: Open the SunSpec control gate (11790 = 0x5355)
recipes.summary: SunSpec control writes to 40000-40478 are accepted only while the installer gate 11790 holds 0x5355.

preconditions.text: SunSpec map present: 40000-40001 read 0x5375 0x6E53 ('SunS').
Firmware applies: the third field of 1.Vr reads 1130 or higher.
One writing connection on port 502 (write control).

steps.description: Open the gate (0x5355). Any other value closes it.

failure_and_recovery: While the gate is closed every SunSpec write is answered with exception 0x04.
Closing the gate (any other value) releases every held SunSpec control within 1 s and erases its setpoints.

Even with the gate open, writes are refused with 0x04 while the inverter is switched off (12000 = 0), the emergency stop is set (12021), the unit is not commissioned, the native watchdog is in SAFE_STATE or the external meter is in its meter-lost safe state.
notes: The gate value is stored in non-volatile memory and survives a restart.
No authentication: while the gate is open, any Modbus TCP client that reaches port 502 can command the inverter. Protect port 502 on the network.

recipes.title: SunSpec active-power limit (model 123 WMaxLimPct) applied under EMS control
recipes.summary: Writes the active-power limit, timers and enable in one frame. The limit is applied only while the unit operates under EMS control (mode 20): a SunSpec forced charge/discharge command or native EMS external control with 11045.

preconditions.text: Control gate open (recipe sunspec.open_write_gate).
Unit under EMS control: recipe sunspec.forced_charge / sunspec.forced_discharge, or native.ems_session_start + native.active_power_setpoint.

steps.description: WMaxLimPct = 500 (50.0 %, WMaxLimPct_SF = -1), WinTms = 0, RvrtTms = 60 s, RmpTms = 0, WMaxLim_Ena = 1.
Control-truth block in one request.
Keep-alive: re-write WMaxLim_Ena = 1.

repeat.interval: at most one third of RvrtTms (20 s for 60 s) and well below 30 s

confirm.meaning: limit in force in the control layer
limit selected for dispatch, 0.01 % of rated power
resulting upper bound of the AC output

failure_and_recovery: 17290 = 3 with 17358 = 1: the limit is held but the unit runs its own operating mode; establish EMS control.
The SunSpec limit is combined with the native limit by taking the lower value: it can lower, never raise it.
Released on RvrtTms expiry, gate closure, machine veto or restart; the unit then applies its own limit. After RvrtTms expiry writing only the enable (40079 = 1) re-activates the last setpoints.
Release on purpose: write 40079 = 0 (the override stops at once).
notes: RvrtTms must be 0 or greater than WinTms; otherwise the frame is answered with exception 0x03.
Write only the points you change; never write back a block you have read.

recipes.title: SunSpec forced charge (model 124: DISCHARGE bit with negative OutWRte)
recipes.summary: Forces the battery to charge at a share of 124.WChaMax; the unit changes to EMS control (mode 20).

preconditions.text: Control gate open.
Native EMS interface inactive (native watchdog disabled).
124.WChaMax above 0 (it is the reference of OutWRte / InWRte).
Inverter switched on.

steps.description: OutWRte = -4000 (-40.00 % of WChaMax, InOutWRte_SF = -2), InWRte = 0, WinTms = 0, RvrtTms = 60 s, RmpTms = 0.
StorCtl_Mod = 2 (DISCHARGE bit): the negative OutWRte forces charging.
Keep-alive: re-write the same StorCtl_Mod.

repeat.interval: at most one third of RvrtTms (20 s for 60 s) and well below 30 s

confirm.meaning: forced setpoint per phase, 0.01 kW, positive = AC output

failure_and_recovery: Released by InOutWRte_RvrtTms expiry, gate closure, machine veto or restart. After RvrtTms expiry StorCtl_Mod reads 0 but the mode is kept: the next accepted write to any storage point re-activates it.
To restart with new values: 40101 = 0 (0x06), then the 0x10 frame from 40108, then 40101.
With native 11700 not 0 the storage control is outranked (14240 high byte 3).
Stop on purpose: write 40101 = 0 (the override stops at once).
14240 low byte 7: the charge and discharge bounds exclude each other and the battery is held at 0 W.
notes: The unit runs the bound nearest to 0 W as AC active-power setpoint, split equally over the three phases.
Close the power loop on 203.W (grid meter).

recipes.title: SunSpec forced discharge (model 124: CHARGE bit with negative InWRte)
recipes.summary: Forces the battery to discharge at a share of 124.WChaMax; the unit changes to EMS control (mode 20).

preconditions.text: Control gate open.
Native EMS interface inactive (native watchdog disabled).
124.WChaMax above 0.
Inverter switched on.

steps.description: OutWRte = 0, InWRte = -4000 (-40.00 % of WChaMax), WinTms = 0, RvrtTms = 60 s, RmpTms = 0.
StorCtl_Mod = 1 (CHARGE bit): the negative InWRte forces discharging.
Keep-alive: re-write the same StorCtl_Mod.

repeat.interval: at most one third of RvrtTms (20 s for 60 s) and well below 30 s

confirm.meaning: forced setpoint per phase, 0.01 kW, positive = AC output

failure_and_recovery: Released by InOutWRte_RvrtTms expiry, gate closure, machine veto or restart. After RvrtTms expiry StorCtl_Mod reads 0 but the mode is kept: the next accepted write to any storage point re-activates it.
To restart with new values: 40101 = 0 (0x06), then the 0x10 frame from 40108, then 40101.
With native 11700 not 0 the storage control is outranked (14240 high byte 3).
Stop on purpose: write 40101 = 0 (the override stops at once).
notes: Combine with recipe sunspec.active_power_limit to bound the AC output while discharging.
Close the power loop on 203.W (grid meter).
